result.title: PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model
result.summary: Understanding a scene requires both geometry and semantics: geometry recovers its spatial structure, and semantics separates it into objects. Current models obtain the two from separate networks or separate passes. We present PINE, a one-step Omni Diffusion Transformer that predicts the point map, the surface normals, and the instance map of an image in one forward pass. PINE treats each map as a token stream, and a stream mask decides which streams interact. A camera-aware ray encoding positions every token by its camera ray rather than its pixel. Grounding attention adds the affinity of pretrained DINOv3 features to the attention logits. Trained on only 139K synthetic images for geometry, PINE achieves state-of-the-art point maps whether or not intrinsics are given and the best average rank on surface normals. It also exceeds SAM on large objects with less than 1 percent of its training images, and it predicts all three maps 5.7x faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PINE，用单步 Omni Diffusion Transformer 在一次前向中同时预测点图、表面法向与实例图，把每种图视为一条 token 流并用流掩码控制流间交互，配合相机射线编码与 DINOv3 特征注意力增强几何和语义预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其单步扩散一次前向并行产出多路 latent 地图、并以流掩码显式约束跨流信息交换的做法，可能为 LVR 的并行 latent 状态生成与跨模态信息坍缩控制提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不研究多模态推理。
